title: kbdecide sweep leaves a decision active when its item was dropped outside a sprint
goal: kbdecide.py sweep invalidates a decision whose context item backlog.py drop deleted outside a sprint (its last version in git history is not done), and content-rules.md and tools.md describe that case.

run: set -e; d=$(mktemp -d); git clone -q "$PWD" "$d/r"; cd "$d/r"; python3 _tools/kbdecide.py record --root _self --source "backlog item BG-3i46pccw gate g1" --context item:BG-3i46pccw --by operator --maker operator -- "Keep the rustc check" >/dev/null; python3 _tools/backlog.py drop BG-3i46pccw --why test >/dev/null; git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@example.com commit -qam drop --no-verify; python3 _tools/kbdecide.py sweep --root _self --dry-run | grep -q "would_invalidate=1"
